title: แก้วันเริ่ม/สิ้นสุดงาน แล้วเวลาทำงานที่บันทึกไว้หายจากงวดและ CSV โดยไม่มีคำเตือน
trigger: Employee clocks 2026-10-05 08:30-17:30; HR saves employmentStartDate=2026-10-06 (or an end date before the last worked day); HR creates and closes period 2026-10-03..05.
actual: saveEmployee written=true; the attendance day still has clockInAt/clockOutAt; preview blocker=null, workedMinutes=0; close succeeds; CSV has 3 filler rows and no EMP-001 row.
expected: Recorded attendance outside a new employment range is refused/flagged at save, or appears as a blocking exception; never silently excluded from frozen payroll output (HR-041, HR-051).
impact: Worked time silently missing from closed period versions and CSV export; also hides pending corrections/certifications outside the range.
verification: pnpm exec vitest run --config docs/reviews/daily-bug-search-2026-10-13/expanded/kiro/vitest.config.mts hr-backend -t KIRO-01
fixDirection: Guard saveEmployee like EMPLOYEE_SITE_LOCKED when recorded/certified/pending days fall outside the new range, or emit RECORDED_OUTSIDE_EMPLOYMENT exception rows in buildPeriodRows.

title: แก้ตารางงาน/วันหยุดย้อนหลัง ทำให้วันขาดงานหายและเกิด exception ปลอม
trigger: Mon-Fri employee has no record on Mon 2026-10-05; on 10-07 HR changes schedule to Tue-Sat (or adds a holiday on 10-05, or deletes a past holiday).
actual: Queue before: 2026-10-05 MISSING_RECORD. After schedule edit: 10-05 gone, new 2026-10-03 (Saturday, previously unscheduled) MISSING_RECORD. After adding holiday: queue empty.
expected: An unaccounted absence remains identifiable until dispositioned (HR-033, A7); schedule changes do not retroactively create absences for days the employee was not scheduled.
impact: Absences disappear without any reviewer decision (absentDays undercounted after close); phantom exceptions block closing; affects queue, draft periods, history and day detail.
verification: pnpm exec vitest run --config docs/reviews/daily-bug-search-2026-10-13/expanded/kiro/vitest.config.mts hr-backend -t KIRO-02
fixDirection: Effective-dated schedule history (effectiveFrom) or materialize past plans before schedule/holiday edits; require confirmation for past-date holiday changes.

title: หน้า Today และค่า today ไม่อัปเดตเมื่อเวลาผ่านไป ข้ามวันแล้วไม่มีปุ่มลงเวลาเข้า
trigger: Clock out on 2026-10-12, leave Today open overnight, use it on 2026-10-13 without reload.
actual: Same database, no writes: query answers ['2026-10-12','CLOCKED_OUT','NONE'] at 23:50 and ['2026-10-13','NOT_CLOCKED_IN','CLOCK_IN'] at 08:20. Convex does not re-run queries when Date.now() changes (docs.convex.dev best-practices #date-in-queries) and the client has no timer/visibility refresh, so the stale screen shows no Clock in button; similar staleness for open-day expiry, period blocker and access.today defaults.
expected: Today shows the organization's current business date and next action (HR-020).
impact: Employees cannot clock in from a long-open page until reload; misleading state on all time-dependent HR screens. Mutations stay correct.
verification: pnpm exec vitest run --config docs/reviews/daily-bug-search-2026-10-13/expanded/kiro/vitest.config.mts hr-backend -t KIRO-08 (documents time-only change); manual: keep Today open across midnight in local dev
fixDirection: Pass a coarse client business date/minute bucket as a query argument (per Convex guidance) and bump it on day/minute boundaries and visibilitychange; or move time transitions into scheduled writes.
limits: Convex subscription behaviour taken from official documentation; websocket reconnect behaviour not verified.

title: HR admin ที่จำกัดคลัง A เพิ่ม/ถอนสิทธิ์ HR ของสมาชิกคลัง B ได้
trigger: WAREHOUSE_SCOPED HR admin (ALPHA only) calls accessMembers and setMemberAccess(revoke HR_SUPERVISOR) for a supervisor scoped only to BRAVO.
actual: Out-of-scope member listed=true; revoke written=true; the BRAVO supervisor's review.queue then fails (ok=false).
expected: Role management limited to members inside the admin's site scope, or requires ORG_WIDE scope, as the module contract states.
impact: Scoped administrators can disable or grant HR access organization-wide and see all members' HR roles.
verification: pnpm exec vitest run --config docs/reviews/daily-bug-search-2026-10-13/expanded/kiro/vitest.config.mts hr-backend -t KIRO-04
fixDirection: Filter members by membershipWarehouses within siteScope, or refuse unless scopeMode is ORG_WIDE.

title: HR admin รับรองเวลาของตัวเองได้ โดยยกเลิกการเชื่อมบัญชีก่อน
trigger: HR admin with their own employee record: disposeDay on own day, then unlink own record, disposeDay again, relink.
actual: Direct attempt SELF_REVIEW; unlink written; dispose WORKED 08:30-17:30 written; relink written; certification.decidedByUserId is the admin.
expected: No self-certification by HR administrators (HR-001, HR-033, role table) regardless of temporary link changes.
impact: Privileged insider can certify own attendance in three commands (audit rows remain). Inverse variant lets an unlinked admin link to another employee and clock for them (HR-011).
verification: pnpm exec vitest run --config docs/reviews/daily-bug-search-2026-10-13/expanded/kiro/vitest.config.mts hr-backend -t KIRO-03
fixDirection: Forbid an actor changing userId on a record linked to themselves or linking their own account; or check link/actor history in reviewBlocker.

title: มีประวัติพนักงานในคลังเกิน 99 รายการ งวดและคิวตรวจของ admin ใช้ไม่ได้อีก แม้คนที่ยังทำงานมีน้อย
trigger: Site with 100 former (ended 2024, INACTIVE) employee records and 2 current employees; create period 2026-09-01..30; HR admin opens review queue.
actual: periods.create refused PERIOD_TOO_LARGE/EMPLOYEES; admin review.queue LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
expected: Bound applies to employees in the period (max 50, spec line 20 / UI limitsValue), not the lifetime registry.
impact: Permanent block on periods/close/export and admin queue for high-turnover sites (employees cannot be deleted).
verification: pnpm exec vitest run --config docs/reviews/daily-bug-search-2026-10-13/expanded/kiro/vitest.config.mts hr-backend -t KIRO-05
fixDirection: Read only employees whose employment overlaps the range (index or pagination), then apply the 50-employee bound.

title: ฟอร์มพนักงานที่ยังไม่บันทึกถูกล้างเงียบ ๆ เมื่อ admin อีกคนบันทึก record เดียวกัน
trigger: Admin A edits employee name (unsaved); admin B saves the same employee so the live query moves v4 -> v5.
actual: EmployeeForm remounts via key id:version; typed name reverts to 'Somsak'; no draft prompt; guard entry unregistered.
expected: Keep the draft and show it is stale (server already returns EMPLOYEE_STALE); require consent before discarding (back-navigation contract, A14).
impact: Silent loss of unsaved HR edits; same keying pattern for correction/disposition/decision forms on revision/version change (source-demonstrated).
verification: pnpm exec vitest run --config docs/reviews/daily-bug-search-2026-10-13/expanded/kiro/vitest.config.mts hr-ui -t KIRO-10
fixDirection: Key by record id only; on version change keep dirty drafts with a stale banner and refresh clean ones.
related: DAILY-03 (inverse symptom in ShortcutCustomizeScreen; different component and mechanism)

title: ฟอร์มแก้เวลาตัดวินาที ด้านที่ไม่ได้แก้จึงถูกแสดงว่าเปลี่ยนและเวลาเลื่อน
trigger: Clock-in 08:30:45, clock-out 17:30:10; employee changes only the end to 18:00 with the prefilled start untouched.
actual: proposedStartAt is 45 s earlier than originalStartAt; reviewer comparison marks Clock in as changed; certified interval lengthens by up to 59 s (can add 1 worked minute).
expected: Untouched side keeps the original instant and is not shown as changed.
impact: Misleading review evidence on nearly every correction; minute-level drift in certified time.
verification: pnpm exec vitest run --config docs/reviews/daily-bug-search-2026-10-13/expanded/kiro/vitest.config.mts hr-backend -t KIRO-07
fixDirection: Send undefined for untouched sides (per-side dirty tracking) or the original instant; compare at minute granularity in UI.

title: รับรองคำขอแก้ระหว่างกะที่ยังเปิดอยู่ แล้วพนักงานลงเวลาออกไม่ได้
trigger: Clock in 09:00; at 10:05 submit correction 08:00-10:00 (form needs an end not in the future); supervisor certifies 10:10; clock out at 17:30.
actual: Day status IN_PROGRESS at submission; certify sets open=false; clockOut refused HR_NOT_CLOCKED_IN; Today CLOCKED_OUT/NONE; the real end is never recorded.
expected: Refuse corrections/certification that end a still-open shift, or keep the shift open until a real clock-out.
impact: Lost clock-out and under-recorded day; recoverable only by another correction request.
verification: pnpm exec vitest run --config docs/reviews/daily-bug-search-2026-10-13/expanded/kiro/vitest.config.mts hr-backend -t KIRO-06
fixDirection: Disallow correction submission/certification while IN_PROGRESS, or preserve open when no original clock-out exists.

title: งวด 1-15 ต.ค. ที่ไม่ระบุปีและยังไม่จบงวด ถูกตีความเป็นปีที่แล้ว
trigger: On 2026-10-13 query 'ส่งออกงวด 1-15 ต.ค.' with an existing 2026-10-01..15 draft period.
actual: Reading 2025-10-01..2025-10-15 (inferredYear); periodsByRange called with 2025 dates; outcome NO_MATCH (or last year's period offered for confirmation).
expected: A year-less range that started on or before today resolves to the current year; the no-future rule fits single self-correction dates only.
impact: Common HR period queries fail or point at the wrong year (confirmation required, so no automatic wrong action).
fixDirection: For ranges choose the latest year where from <= today (or offer both years); keep end <= today only for self-day corrections.

title: รายการวันที่ยังเปิดของงวดตัดที่ 200 แถวโดยไม่แจ้ง exception ท้ายรายการจึงไม่แสดง
trigger: Draft period 1-31 Oct viewed on 13 Oct: 12 employees with 18 UPCOMING days each, a 13th employee with a MISSING_RECORD exception.
actual: 217 unresolved rows, 200 listed, the exception row not shown, no truncation notice.
expected: Bounded lists say they are incomplete (HR-051); exceptions should not be hidden behind upcoming days.
impact: Reviewers miss exceptions in the period work list; totals remain correct.
verification: pnpm exec vitest run --config docs/reviews/daily-bug-search-2026-10-13/expanded/kiro/vitest.config.mts hr-ui -t KIRO-11
fixDirection: List EXCEPTION rows first and show an 'N more' notice or full/virtualized list.
